exposure: perioperative management of antithrombotic medications (discontinued at least a day before surgery vs. continued through surgical period)
cohort: Patients who underwent breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer at a single university hospital between 2010 and 2022.
finding: The risk for bleeding complications was elevated, but still low, after breast-conserving surgery when antithrombotic medications were continued through the surgical period, but not if discontinued at least a day prior.
